sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Luxembourg – Corporate – Taxes on corporate income
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary, not an official source: corporate income tax 15% to EUR 175,000, 17% above EUR 200,000, solidarity surtax 7%, overall 24.94% in Luxembourg City with the 6.75% municipal business tax.

sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Luxembourg – Individual – Taxes on personal income
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary: progressive scale from 8% above EUR 13,230 to 42% above EUR 234,870, adapted as of 2025.

sources.title: Worldwide Tax Summaries: Luxembourg – Corporate – Other taxes
sources.note: A professional firm’s summary: VAT 17%, 14%, 8% and 3%; employee social contributions (sickness 2.80%, pension 8%).

sources.title: Pre-2023 VAT rates reinstated in Luxembourg
sources.note: News report: the VAT rates of 17%, 14% and 8% were reinstated on 1 January 2024 after the temporary cut of 2023.
